visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a vivid close-up shot of a black frying pan where a blue spatula is vigorously stirring a chunky, textured red chili oil mixture. Many small seeds and chili fragments are clearly visible, glistening under the bright lights as they are tossed around the pan. (2) A seamless transition reveals a tight close-up of the finished chili sauce, now containing dark, fermented black beans. The sauce is piled onto a rustic black dish, and the overhead lighting highlights the oily, spicy texture and rich colors of the condiments. (3) A charismatic male host appears in a medium shot. He wears a clean, professional white chef's jacket featuring a small logo. He stands in a well-lit studio kitchen against a textured grey wall, speaking directly to the camera with high energy and expressive hand gestures. (4) The sequence shifts to a clear top-down view of the black wok. A pair of hands pours a stream of golden oil from a small glass bowl. Next, dried chili flakes and freshly chopped red chilies are added, and the blue spatula begins to stir them into the hot oil. (5) A close-up showcases a glass jar of 'Hei Dou Sang' fermented black beans. A stainless steel spoon is used to scoop out several servings of the dark beans, which are then added directly into the bubbling chili mixture on the stovetop. (6) The cooking process continues as the chef adds liquid ingredients from glass bottles and small bowls, including a dark soy sauce and a clear cooking wine, followed by a spoonful of white sugar. The spatula keeps the mixture moving until it achieves a thick consistency. (7) A close-up shot focuses on a spoon holding a portion of the savory chili sauce as it is placed onto a bowl of fluffy, steaming white rice. The steam rises softly from the rice, emphasizing the freshness and heat of the prepared dish. (8) The video concludes with the host back in the medium-shot studio setting. He continues his upbeat presentation, pointing toward the camera and gesturing to the bowl of rice and the jar of sauce on the table, inviting viewers to try the recipe.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天要教你們一個我. (2) [Subtitle]: 冰箱裡的祕密武器. (3) [Subtitle]: 那就是自製的. [Slogan]: 豆豉辣椒醬. (4) [Subtitle]: 首先下一大匙的油 加入 乾辣椒碎 60g 新鮮辣椒 40g. (5) [Subtitle]: 結合乾辣椒的香 和新鮮辣椒的辣. (6) [Subtitle]: 口感上會更有層次喔 炒出紅油後. (7) [Subtitle]: 加入 蒜末 50g 薑末 50g. (8) [Subtitle]: 一起煸出香氣. (9) [Subtitle]: 再來就是我個人的 小訣竅啦. (10) [Subtitle]: 加入 黑豆桑黑豆豉. (11) [Subtitle]: 天然發酵的鹹香味 讓整鍋醬香直接升級. (12) [Subtitle]: 底蘊超有層次 哇 這一定是外面 吃不到的辣椒醬. (13) [Subtitle]: 接著加入 黑豆桑薄鹽醬油 1大匙. (14) [Subtitle]: 米酒 1大匙 糖 1大匙. (15) [Subtitle]: 拌炒到有一點稠度 就可以盛裝啦. (16) [Subtitle]: 放入冰箱冷藏 大約可以保存 1-2個月. (17) [Subtitle]: 想吃的時候 隨時拿出來用. (18) [Subtitle]: 香辣帶勁 配飯神器. (19) [Subtitle]: 拿來拌麵 炒菜 沾水餃 都超級搭. (20) [Subtitle]: 這個豆豉辣椒醬 誰吃誰上癮. (21) [Subtitle]: 喜歡吃辣的朋友 你們趕快試試看.
